items.title: M&T Bank (MTB) Stock Trades At A Discount To Fair Value As Earnings Look Fair
items.summary: M&T Bank stock has returned 120.4% over the past five years, and the current Excess Returns intrinsic value estimate points to the shares trading at a discount while earnings based multiples look roughly in line with the market.
